name: Vinyl record
definition: Vinyl disc with fine grooves played at 33 1/3, 45 or another speed (LP, EP, single); diameter, speed, release type, weight and mastering are noted.

name: 78 rpm record
definition: Shellac or early disc with wide grooves, played at about 78 rpm with a coarse stylus.

name: Flexi-disc
definition: thin flexible vinyl sheet record, often bound into magazines.

name: Acetate or lathe-cut disc
definition: disc cut one at a time on a recording lathe, as an acetate or lacquer, not pressed.

name: Cylinder record
definition: sound recorded in the groove of a cylinder (wax or celluloid) for a phonograph.

name: Compact cassette
definition: Audio tape in the standard two-hub compact cassette shell, pre-recorded or blank; the tape type is noted.

name: Microcassette
definition: Audio tape in a cassette smaller than the compact cassette (microcassette, minicassette, picocassette).

name: CD
definition: 12 cm optical disc in the Compact Disc Digital Audio system (16-bit, 44.1 kHz), audiobook CDs included; HDCD and special pressings such as SHM-CD are noted.

name: SACD
definition: Super Audio CD carrying DSD audio, single-layer or hybrid with a CD layer; whether it is hybrid is noted.

name: DVD-Audio
definition: DVD-format disc carrying high-resolution audio (up to 24-bit/192 kHz).

name: Mini CD
definition: 8 cm compact disc needing a tray recess or adapter.

name: Audiobook player
definition: Self-contained device sold with one work, usually an audiobook, fixed on it; it plays only that work.

name: VHS cassette
definition: video recording on half-inch tape in a VHS cassette.

name: Betamax cassette
definition: video recording on half-inch tape in a Betamax cassette.

name: LaserDisc
definition: 30 cm (or 20 cm) optical disc carrying analogue video.

name: DVD
definition: 12 cm optical disc carrying standard-definition digital video.

name: Blu-ray
definition: 12 cm optical disc in the Blu-ray system carrying high-definition video.

name: Ultra HD Blu-ray
definition: 12 cm optical disc in the Ultra HD Blu-ray system, sold apart from Blu-ray.

name: 35 mm print
definition: commercially released film print on 35 mm stock.

name: 16 mm print
definition: commercially released film print on 16 mm stock.

name: Super 8 print
definition: commercially released film print on Super 8 stock.

name: Loose dust jacket
definition: loose paper wrapper made to cover one hardback book, sold apart from the book.

name: Slipcase
definition: open-ended box made to hold and protect one book or one set issued together.

name: Comic bag
definition: clear plastic bag sized to hold one comic issue.

name: Backing board
definition: stiff board placed behind one comic in its bag to keep it flat.

name: Record inner sleeve
definition: paper or poly sleeve that holds one record disc inside its jacket.

name: Record outer sleeve
definition: clear protective sleeve made to cover one record jacket.

name: CD jewel case
definition: hinged plastic case made to hold one compact disc with its booklet and tray card.

name: Globe stand
definition: stand, cradle or meridian ring sold for one globe.

name: Hardback book
definition: Book bound in rigid boards; binding (trade cloth, library or reinforced, leather or fine binding) and size are noted.

name: Paperback book
definition: Book bound in a flexible paper cover, trade and mass-market alike; trim size and paper class are noted.

name: Spiral-bound book
definition: Book whose leaves are held by a wire or plastic spiral or comb.

name: Loose-leaf book
definition: Book issued as punched loose leaves held in a ring binder or post binding.

name: Pamphlet
definition: Short publication of a few sheets bound by staples or saddle-stitching.

name: Board book
definition: Book printed on thick laminated paperboard pages, made for young children.

name: Cloth, bath or foam book
definition: Book with pages of cloth, waterproof plastic or foam, made for babies.

name: Sewing or knitting pattern
definition: Printed single-pattern sheet or envelope for sewing or knitting, issued loose rather than bound; craft, size range and garment are noted.

name: Single-issue comic
definition: Comic issue of one serial number, stapled through the fold (the "floppy").

name: Collected softcover volume
definition: Softcover volume collecting several issues or chapters of a comic or manga.

name: Collected hardcover volume
definition: hardcover volume collecting several issues or chapters (label_source: memo).

name: Omnibus
definition: Thick single volume collecting a long run of issues or several collected volumes; the binding is noted.

name: Pocket-size reissue
definition: small-format reprint edition of a comic or manga already issued in collected volumes (bunkoban; label_source: memo).

name: Premium large-format edition
definition: oversized deluxe edition on large trim and heavier paper (Absolute, kanzenban; label_source: memo).

name: Newspaper
definition: Periodical issued daily or weekly on unbound newsprint sheets; page format (broadsheet, Berliner, tabloid) is noted.

name: Magazine
definition: Periodical issue bound as a stapled or perfect-bound paper-covered booklet, digest-size magazines included; page format is noted.

name: Bound periodical volume
definition: Book-form volume binding together a run of issues of one periodical.

name: Zine
definition: small self-published or fan-made periodical, usually photocopied or short-run and stapled.

name: Full score
definition: printed score showing every part of an ensemble work on the page at full size.

name: Miniature score
definition: full score reduced to pocket size for study (pocket score, Studienpartitur).

name: Vocal score
definition: score with the vocal parts in full and the accompaniment reduced for piano.

name: Score and parts
definition: score issued together with the separate parts for each performer.

name: Set of parts
definition: the separate performers' parts of a work issued without the score.

name: Choral octavo
definition: single choral work printed in octavo format for choir use.

name: Songbook
definition: bound collection of songs or pieces, in notation for voice, piano or another instrument, lead-sheet books included.

name: Folded map
definition: Printed map sheet folded to pocket size for carrying; the area covered is noted.

name: Wall map
definition: map printed or mounted to hang flat on a wall, laminated or not.

name: Map booklet
definition: map issued as a small stapled or bound booklet of map sections.

name: Bound atlas
definition: Book of maps bound in boards, a flexible cover or flexi-binding; the area covered is noted.

name: Spiral-bound atlas
definition: book of maps held by a wire or plastic spiral so it lies flat (road atlases).

name: Desktop globe
definition: globe on a short base or stand made to sit on a desk or table, mini globes included.

name: Floor globe
definition: globe on a tall floor-standing stand or frame.

name: Hanging globe
definition: globe made to hang from a ceiling or bracket.

name: Fold-out book
definition: Book printed on one long sheet folded concertina-wise into pages (leporello), opening out to its full length.

name: Part-work
definition: Publication issued as numbered parts sold weekly or monthly that together build one complete work; binders and models are sold apart.

name: Novelty book
definition: Book built with moving or added parts (pop-up, lift-the-flap, pull-tab, sound or touch-and-feel pages).

name: Piano reduction
definition: Edition of an ensemble or concerto work with the orchestra or ensemble reduced for piano, usually with the solo part.

name: Single part
definition: One performer's part of an ensemble work issued and sold alone, without score or other parts.

name: Tear-off map pad
definition: Pad of identical printed map sheets bound at one edge so each sheet can be torn off and carried.

name: Bookazine
definition: One-off magazine-style publication with a book number, sold in bookshops and newsstands, often in a numbered series.

name: Regular 8 mm print
definition: Commercially released film print on regular (double) 8 mm stock, needing a regular 8 projector.

name: Book jacket cover
definition: Clear polyester or film cover made to fit over one book's dust jacket to protect it.

name: Book box
definition: Closed box made to hold and protect one book or one set, lid dropping over or hinged as a clamshell.

name: S-VHS cassette
definition: Video recording on half-inch tape in the Super VHS system, needing an S-VHS deck for its full resolution.

name: VHS-C cassette
definition: Compact VHS cassette, mainly blank for camcorders, played in a VHS deck through an adapter.

name: W-VHS cassette
definition: Video recording on half-inch tape in JVC's high-definition W-VHS system, needing a W-VHS deck.

name: CD-R
definition: Recordable compact disc, sold blank or as a short-run release, written once in a CD burner.

name: Vertical-cut disc
definition: Disc record cut with a vertical (hill-and-dale) groove, played with its own reproducer; Edison Diamond Disc and Pathé discs are examples.

name: 16-inch transcription disc
definition: 16-inch disc made for broadcast playback on a transcription deck.
